_note: Register fragment for publication-withdrawal-aftercare. REQ-PWA-002: the depublication says what the public tombstone of a withdrawn publication tells a reader: a public reason beside the internal one, and whether it names the title. REQ-PWA-003: the publication schema offers OpenRegister's archive and freeze, so a withdrawn publication is frozen with its reason, and the depublication records whether that freeze worked. The versions are the merged ones, so the last fragment in name order (woo-x-access-boundary-hardening.json) carries the same bumps.

publicReason.title: Public reason
publicReason.description: Why the publication was withdrawn, as the public link tells a reader.

tombstoneShowsTitle.title: Show the title after withdrawal
tombstoneShowsTitle.description: Whether the public link of the withdrawn publication still shows its title.

frozen.title: Frozen
frozen.description: Whether the withdrawn publication was frozen, so it refuses every edit.

frozenError.title: Why it was not frozen
frozenError.description: What went wrong when the withdrawn publication could not be frozen.
